_note: siteUrl: the deployed origin (custom domain once you have one); used only by tools/prerender.js to make og:image/og:url absolute — link previews need absolute URLs. imageBase: where /<id>/<n>.webp photos are served from — '/img' means alongside the site, an absolute URL (https://img.example.com) means object storage, in which case client/public/img/ is not needed to build a complete site. contactEmail: shown on /privacy as the controller's contact. Rebuild + redeploy after changing any of them. SITE_URL and IMAGE_BASE_URL env vars override the first two.
